name: Shop UX Toolkit
author: Jim

sections.description:
The Shop UX Toolkit plugin enhances your WooCommerce store by fixing design and accessibility issues on shop and product pages. It’s designed and tested for the Storefront theme (vanilla) and uses CSS to modify only WooCommerce code, leaving your theme untouched. This means it doesn’t interfere with your site’s design and will likely work with other themes showing similar issues (e.g., links without underlines or hover effects), though we recommend testing it. All features can be toggled on or off in the settings, and the plugin is lightweight, making it ideal even if you only need one feature.

Improves Link Appearance
– What it does: Adds underlines to WooCommerce page links (which lack underlines in Storefront) and removes them on hover, using CSS.
– Why it’s helpful: Underlined links are easier to spot, improving readability and fixing Google PageSpeed Insights errors for links that rely only on color, enhancing accessibility and potentially boosting SEO.

Adds Hover Effects to Category and Product Boxes
– What it does: Applies a subtle lift and shadow effect to category and product boxes on hover, via CSS.
– Why it’s helpful: Signals that boxes are clickable, creating a polished, engaging look that encourages clicks and can increase click-through rates (CTR) and sales.

Customizes Focus Outlines
– What it does: Lets you toggle focus outlines (visible borders around clickable elements) to appear only for keyboard navigation, not mouse/touch, using CSS.
– Why it’s helpful: Ensures accessibility for keyboard users (including those with disabilities) while providing a cleaner look for mouse/touch users, balancing functionality and aesthetics.

Why Choose This Plugin?
– Enhanced User Experience: Clear links and interactive hover effects make your shop easier to navigate and more inviting.
– Accessibility Compliance: Meets standards for users with visual impairments or assistive technologies.
– Increased Engagement: Clickable cues encourage more clicks, potentially driving higher sales.
– SEO Benefits: Resolving PageSpeed Insights errors may improve search engine rankings.
– Polished Design: Creates a consistent, professional look, building customer trust.
– Flexible and Lightweight: Toggle features on or off with minimal impact on site speed.
– Broad Compatibility: Likely works with themes showing similar WooCommerce issues, though tested only with Storefront.

Live demo: https://www.smokingblends.com — hover product boxes, check description links, and Tab to see the focus option.

Usage

Use the Settings page to toggle link underlines, hover lift, and keyboard focus.

Contributing

Free plugin, Storefront-first. Suggest changes via the WordPress.org Support forum with WP, Woo, and theme versions, steps, and minimal code.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit personal data, and makes no external requests.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Plugins → Installed Plugins → Shop UX Toolkit → Settings to enable/disable features.
  4. Clear any page cache or CDN after changing settings.
sections.faq:
What does the Shop UX Toolkit plugin do?

It enhances WooCommerce shop and product pages with better links, hover effects on category/product boxes, and customizable focus outlines for improved UX, accessibility, and engagement.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

It’s designed and tested for Storefront (vanilla) but uses CSS to modify only WooCommerce code, so it likely works with other themes showing similar issues (e.g., no link underlines). Test it to confirm.

Can I customize the plugin’s features?

Yes, toggle link underlines, hover effects, and focus outlines on or off in the settings to use only the features you need.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes, it uses only CSS, ensuring minimal impact on site speed, making it ideal even if you use just one feature.

How does it improve accessibility?

It adds link underlines to meet accessibility standards and keeps focus outlines for keyboard navigation, ensuring usability for people with visual impairments.

Will it help my site’s SEO?

Yes, fixing Google PageSpeed Insights errors (e.g., links relying only on color) can improve SEO and search engine rankings.

Do I need coding skills to use it?

No, install and activate it, then adjust settings via the WordPress dashboard. A “Settings” link appears on the Plugins page for easy access.

Can I use just one feature, like hover effects?

Yes, enable or disable any feature in the settings, such as using only hover effects.

Can I customize focus outlines for navigation?

Yes, toggle focus outlines (visible borders around clickable elements) to show only for keyboard navigation, not mouse/touch, via settings. This ensures accessibility while keeping a clean look.

How do I know if the plugin is working?

Check your WooCommerce shop/product pages for underlined links, hover effects on boxes, and focus outline behavior. Test accessibility with tools like Google PageSpeed Insights.
